about: Helstrom's goods and stock (tools/newworld/stockdb.py; contract docs/design/place-studio.md, Stock). The containers, loose things, people's possessions and traders' lists are written by the place-stock skill (lane S2).

goods.why: Its market traders sell Murkwood feathers.
Its market traders sell sap; a sap and herb seller keeps a stall.
Its market traders sell river fish.
The Root-Folk smith works the market smithy's forge.
The market smithy has a tanning rack.
Helstrom does not trade outward: it receives and redistributes what the rivers bring it.
